menu_options.search: Search for a station by name

nucleus.title: Commuter network
nucleus.description: Pick the Cercanías or Rodalies network of your station.

search.title: Search for a station
search.description: Type part of the station name, or leave it empty to list every station of {nucleus}.

manual.title: Station code
manual.description: Enter the station code, for example 18000 for Madrid-Atocha Cercanías or 71801 for Barcelona-Sants.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Renfe service. Try again later.
error.invalid_station_code: Invalid station code. It is a number of three to six digits, for example 18000.
error.station_not_found: No station found with that code.
error.too_many_stations: {count} stations matched. Narrow the search down.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while querying the Renfe service.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Renfe service. Try again later.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error while querying the Renfe service.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the Renfe departure board is polled, in seconds. Renfe regenerates it once a minute.
data_description.max_departures: Number of upcoming trains listed in the next_departures attribute.
data_description.alerts: Publish the Renfe warnings and notices affecting this station and its lines.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Polls Renfe immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled update. Without a target, every configured station is refreshed.

no_station_targeted.message: No loaded Renfe station matched the target of the action.
